children: Ashoka Buildcon share price will remain in focus on November 18 following the company has secured a Rs 1,465 crore contract from the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI).
The order is for the balance construction work of an eight-lane access-controlled expressway on the Vadodara-Mumbai Expressway in Gujarat.
The project covers the 154.6 km to 190 km stretch (Jujuwa to Gandeva section) and will be executed on an Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) basis.
Catch all the market action on our live blog

Earlier this month, the company received a Letter of Acceptance (LoA) from Druk Green Power Corporation Limited, Bhutan, for the design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of a 120 MWp Wobthang Solar PV Power Plant worth USD 58.90 million.

The company also secured an Rs 865.90 crore contract from the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) for the balance construction work of an eight-lane access-controlled expressway on the Vadodara-Mumbai Expressway. The project covers the 128 km to 154.6 km stretch (Karvad to Jujuwa section) in Gujarat and will be executed on an EPC basis.
In the previous trading session, the share closed at Rs 108.09, up Rs 0.27, or 0.25 percent.
The share touched a 52-week high of Rs 189.75 and a 52-week low of Rs 95.40 on 18 November, 2025 and 29 October, 2026, respectively.
Currently, the stock is trading 43.04 percent below its 52-week high and 13.29 percent above its 52-week low.
The market capitalisation of the company stands at Rs 3,034.34 crore.

title: Ashoka Buildcon share price in focus post NHAI contract of Rs 1,465 crore
